title: AaronL725/grok-register
claim: AaronL725/grok-register — 【已存活三个月+，无封号】批量注册稳定 Grok 账号，可直接导入 grok2api 和 cpa 使用，并且可以与cloudflare无限域名邮箱等联动。通过1000+账号连续注册测试。
why_good: Grok Register automates the registration of Grok accounts using real Chromium pages, handling CAPTCHAs and data entry while supporting multiple temporary email services. It ensures successful accounts are logged in real-time and can recover from failures.
value: Developers and researchers pay for Grok Register to automate account creation for testing and learning, capitalizing on the inefficiencies of manual registration processes.
risk: The reliance on third-party email services like Cloudflare may lead to issues if these services change their APIs or impose stricter usage limits.
does: Grok Register automates the registration of Grok accounts using real Chromium pages, handling CAPTCHAs and data entry while supporting multiple temporary email services. It ensures successful accounts are logged in real-time and can recover from failures.
edge: Its unique ability to recover from registration failures without losing successfully created accounts sets it apart from other automation tools.
why_use: Choose Grok Register for its robust failure recovery feature, which prevents data loss and allows for efficient account management, unlike competitors that require manual re-entry.
hook: Batch register 1000+ Grok accounts seamlessly with Grok Register!
